### Judah’s Inheritance
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/judahs-inheritance
Passage: Joshua 15:1-12
Points:
- The division of Canaan into tribal allotments represents the concrete fulfillment of God's covenant promises to Abraham.
- Judah and the Joseph tribes were seated first because Reuben's forfeited birthright had fallen to them.
- Judah received the largest tract of land, defined by natural boundaries between the Dead Sea and the Mediterranean.
- Placing Judah and its rugged topography on the southern frontier provided security and protection for the remaining tribes.
- Great territory brings great responsibility, reminding believers to diligently steward whatever God has entrusted to their care.
